title: Comparative Effectiveness Analysis of Lumpectomy and Mastectomy for Elderly Female Breast Cancer Patients: A Deep Learning-based Big Data Analysis
summary: Deep learning compared lumpectomy and mastectomy outcomes among elderly breast-cancer patients. The publisher Methods and Results were checked; this conclusion is limited to the study cohort, reference standard and validation described there. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
